title: Humedad del suelo satelital (contexto regional)
context: SMAP mide desde el espacio en píxeles de ~9 km: describe la zona, no tu lote. Se muestra la última observación disponible, con días de atraso: no es tiempo real ni un sensor en el campo.

products.name: SMAP L3 enhanced, surface soil moisture (morning pass)
products.label: observado
products.temporal_resolution: daily, with gaps (the satellite passes every 2 to 3 days)
products.reading: Similar to normal for the season (+7 %).
limitations: It measures only the top ~5 cm: it does not represent the water available to roots.
Days without a pass: the series has gaps.
A ~9 km pixel averages many fields, roads and woodland: it is not your field's moisture.
Absolute moisture (m³/m³) depends on the pixel's soil; that is why anomalies and percentiles are used.

products.name: SMAP L4 root-zone soil moisture (0-100 cm)
products.label: modelado
products.temporal_resolution: every 3 hours; aggregated to a daily mean
products.reading: Wetter than normal for the season (+18 %).
limitations: It is a MODELED product: a land model (GEOS-5 Catchment) assimilates SMAP observations.
While the instrument is not observing, the value comes from the model alone.
A ~9 km pixel averages many fields, roads and woodland: it is not your field's moisture.
Absolute moisture (m³/m³) depends on the pixel's soil; that is why anomalies and percentiles are used.
